description: Avoid using Curator's recursive delete because it recurses on KeeperException.NotEmptyException.  The recursion may cause StackOverflowError, JDK-8318888, and deadlock of the config server.  This PR implements an equivalent using iteration.

comments.body:
The exception thrown here is missing the original exception as the cause, which would make debugging difficult. Consider including the exception `e` as the cause parameter in the RuntimeException constructor.
```suggestion
                throw new RuntimeException("Could not get children of " + path.getAbsolute(), e);
```

The path `/config/v2/tenants//TENANT/applications` contains a double slash which appears to be a typo. It should likely be `/config/v2/tenants/TENANT/applications` (single slash).
```suggestion
        //      and one on `/config/v2/tenants/TENANT/applications`.
```
